title: api-robustness-idempotency-retry-after-streaming-openai-compat
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Streaming endpoints and the OpenAI-compat adapter had divergent rate-limit semantics and inconsistent retry behaviour which caused intermittent client-facing 429s and broken client-side retry loops. Motivation: provide a single, predictable contract for rate-limits (429), Retry-After semantics, and idempotency for both streamed and non-streamed API calls while preserving OpenAI compatibility. Summary: - Standardize 429 payloads to include a structured error object with type and retry_after in seconds (example: '{"error":{"type":"rate_limit","retry_after":5}}') for JSON responses and include Retry-After header for both streaming (chunked) and non-streaming endpoints. - Add server-side idempotency-key middleware for streaming requests: capture idempotency-key header at stream start, persist stream state checkpointing for short TTL, and reject duplicate in-flight start attempts with 409 + structured error. - Ensure OpenAI-compat adapter mirrors Redwood semantics (headers, status codes, and body shape) while preserving existing compatibility shims. - Normalize error codes across API paths to a small set: rate_limit, conflict, server_error, invalid_request, auth_error. - Add feature flag api.retry_after_enforcement to allow gradual rollout and a compatibility fallback header X-Redwood-Allow-Legacy-Retry to temporarily preserve old behavior. Checklist: [x] Unit tests for Retry-After header parsing and emitted payloads. [x] Integration test for streaming retry path and idempotency checkpointing. [x] Compatibility tests against openai-compat client test harness. [x] Update API docs and SDK behavior notes. Testing: local unit + integration, staging canary with 10% traffic, observed stable metrics for 48h, expanded to 100% after approval. Rollout plan: enable feature flag for internal customers and staging on 2026-02-15, 10% canary 2026-02-16, 100% 2026-02-18. Backout: toggle feature flag or set X-Redwood-Allow-Legacy-Retry on gateway. Related: ENG-8421 (rate-limit semantics), ENG-8470 (streaming stability), SUP-1243 (customer incident).

merge_commit_msg: Standardize Retry-After + idempotency for streaming and openai-compat. Implements ENG-8421, ENG-8470.
release_notes: Standardized rate-limit behaviour across streaming and non-streaming endpoints: 429 responses now include a structured error payload with type and retry_after, Retry-After header is present for streamed responses, streaming idempotency keys are supported to enable safe retries. Feature flag: api.retry_after_enforcement controls rollout. SDKs updated to surface Retry-After and structured errors.
notes_for_release: Docs updated under docs/openai-compat.md and API changelog. Operators: ensure idempotency.checkpoint_store is configured in production (redis recommended) before enabling feature flag. Monitor 429 counts and stream-duplicate 409s during canary.
